### {.unnumbered .statement .center}

[[01]{.n} / The problem]{.kicker}

[Sports clubs don't have a content shortage.]{.headline .dim}

[They have a content usability problem.]{.headline}

::: notes
Practicality · 25 pts.
Les clubs ont les images. Mais choisir le bon moment, vérifier les usages et préparer une campagne mobilise plusieurs outils et équipes.
Objectif : rendre le problème immédiatement reconnaissable par Tottenham et San Antonio.
:::


### {.unnumbered .statement .center}

[[02]{.n} / The solution]{.kicker}

[Meet PULSE.]{.headline}

[From business intent to human-approved plan.]{.sub}

::: steps
[[1]{.i} Intent]{.step}
[[2]{.i} Rights]{.step}
[[3]{.i} Review]{.step}
:::

[Powered by ScorePlay + TwelveLabs]{.powered}

::: notes
Integration · 25 pts.
Workflow en trois étapes : Intent → Rights & Compliance → Human Review.
ScorePlay apporte les vrais médias et métadonnées ; TwelveLabs retrouve et analyse les moments vidéo.
:::


### {.unnumbered .statement .center}

[[03]{.n} / Why it matters]{.kicker}

[Don't just flag the problem.]{.headline .dim}

[Find a way forward.]{.headline}

::: score
::: {.side .before}
[0/3]{.figure}

[Before]{.label}
:::

::: {.side .after}
[3/3]{.figure}

[After]{.label}
:::
:::

[Uses allowed · Solanke late goal, sponsored post · Instagram, Facebook, X · UK · illustrative rules, not legal clearance]{.fineprint}

::: notes
Novelty · 15 pts.
Le moteur ne se contente pas de bloquer un contenu : il trouve une correction, vérifie indépendamment le nouveau plan et laisse la décision finale à un humain.
Le 0/3 → 3/3 vaut uniquement sous la politique illustrative du scénario Solanke.
:::


### {.unnumbered .statement .center}

[[04]{.n} / Under the hood]{.kicker}

[Two partners. One pipeline.]{.headline}

::: pipeline
::: {.stage .sp}
[1]{.i}

![](images/logos/scoreplay.svg){.mark fig-alt="ScorePlay"}

[Search]{.what}

Tags and squads narrow the library to the clips that fit the goal.
:::

::: {.stage .tl}
[2]{.i}

![](images/logos/twelvelabs.svg){.mark fig-alt="TwelveLabs"}

[Find the moment]{.what}

Marengo search returns the exact seconds, linked back to the ScorePlay asset.
:::

::: {.stage .tl}
[3]{.i}

![](images/logos/twelvelabs.svg){.mark fig-alt="TwelveLabs"}

[Observe]{.what}

Pegasus lists what is on screen and when: brands, crests, players. Evidence, never a licence.
:::

::: {.stage .engine}
[4]{.i}

[PULSE rules]{.mark-text}

[Decide]{.what}

ScorePlay facts plus TwelveLabs evidence, checked per channel × market. No LLM in the verdict.
:::

::: {.stage .tl}
[5]{.i}

![](images/logos/twelvelabs.svg){.mark fig-alt="TwelveLabs"}

[Find a way]{.what}

A cut, or a replacement moment from Marengo, re-checked by the same rules.
:::

::: {.stage .sp}
[6]{.i}

![](images/logos/scoreplay.svg){.mark fig-alt="ScorePlay"}

[Write back]{.what}

After human approval, the decision returns as timecoded video logs (dry run today).
:::
:::

::: notes
Order of use in the Solanke demo: ScorePlay narrows to the 15 videos tagged with Solanke; Marengo finds 0:09–0:20; Pegasus sees the DHL board at 15–17 s; the rules engine blocks 0 of 3 uses; the cut 0:14.5–0:17.5 is re-checked 3 of 3; a named reviewer approves and the log is prepared for ScorePlay as a dry run.
TwelveLabs videos are linked to ScorePlay assets by filename + duration (58/58 Tottenham videos).
:::

### {.unnumbered .statement .center}

[[05]{.n} / Vision]{.kicker}

[Clubs already have access to the content.]{.headline .dim}

[PULSE makes sure they can use it.]{.headline}

::: horizon
::: {.h .now}
[Today]{.when}

Goal → moments → rights → a way forward → human sign-off, on live ScorePlay and TwelveLabs data.
:::

::: {.h .next}
[Pilot · 90 days]{.when}

One club, one partner campaign. The club's own rules replace the demo rules; ScorePlay write-back switched on.
:::

::: {.h .then}
[Scale]{.when}

Every club on ScorePlay. Music, player-status, betting-partner and AI-image checks.
:::
:::

[One club. One partner. One pilot.]{.ask}

::: notes
Closing: clubs already have access to the content; PULSE makes sure they can actually use it — and when they can't, it finds the way that works and shows exactly why.
:::
